title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account, team, integrations, and billing.

security.title: Security
security.passwordlessDescription: You sign in with a one-time code sent to your email. There is no password to manage or reset.
security.changeEmailDescription: We’ll email a one-time code to your new address to confirm it.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Irreversible actions that affect your account.
dangerZone.deleteDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone.
dangerZone.deleteWarning: This deletes workspaces you own, removes you from teams you joined, cancels billing, and permanently deletes your sign-in. This cannot be undone.
dangerZone.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete your account. Please try again.

toasts.codeSent: Code sent to your new address. Enter it below

manualPosting.title: Manual posting
manualPosting.description: Posts for these channels skip automated publishing entirely. When one is due, it lands in your To Post queue and you get a reminder, download the media, post it natively from the app, then mark it as posted. Markaestro never calls the platform’s API for these posts.
manualPosting.manualStatus: Manual: new posts go to the To Post queue.
manualPosting.automatedStatus: Automated: new posts publish via the official API.

integrations.noProductsDescription: Create a brand, then link its social channels here.
integrations.linkDescription: Link each brand to its own social channels. Each channel publishes only to itself: Meta covers Facebook Pages, and Instagram uses the standalone Instagram connection.

pagePicker.title: Choose Facebook Pages
pagePicker.description: Link every Page this brand posts to, from any Facebook account you have connected. Pages stay tied to the account that granted them, and you pick between them when composing.
pagePicker.noneFound: No Facebook Pages were found on your Meta account.

disconnectDialog.warning: This unlinks the channel from this brand only. Other brands keep their own connections. You can re-link any time.

toasts.unlinkFailed: Failed to unlink. Please try again.
toasts.somethingWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
toasts.linkPageFailed: Failed to link this Page. Please try again.

transferDialog.title: Transfer ownership
transferDialog.description: {email} becomes the workspace owner and takes over billing and role management. Your role changes to Admin. This can only be undone by the new owner.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.ownedCount: {count} / {limit, plural, one {# workspace} other {# workspaces}} owned on the {plan} plan

leaveDialog.title: Leave workspace?
leaveDialog.description: You'll lose access to {name}, and any API keys you created there stop working. A workspace admin can invite you back later.

deleteDialog.warning: This permanently deletes the workspace with all its brands, posts, media, connections and API keys, and cancels its subscription. This cannot be undone.

restricted.title: API Access
restricted.description: Only workspace owners and admins can manage API keys and webhook endpoints.

api.title: Public API
api.description: Manage workspace API keys, webhook destinations, and publishing behavior for Meta and TikTok.

infoCards.videoSupportDescription: Public API v1 supports Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok media uploads. TikTok videos follow the same direct inbox handoff as the app before the creator finishes them in TikTok.
infoCards.mediaCapsDescription: TikTok supports either 1 video or up to 10 images per post. Other channels keep their own platform-specific media limits.
infoCards.inboxDescription: TikTok content is pushed to the creator’s TikTok inbox. Markaestro keeps polling TikTok until the platform confirms the inbox item is ready for creator completion.

keysSection.title: API keys
keysSection.description: Create a key per integration, scope it down to the minimum needed access, and watch live request and publish behavior per key.

webhooksSection.title: Webhook endpoints
webhooksSection.description: Receive delivery events when publishes queue, complete, need user action in TikTok, or fail. These are signed and retried from the worker.

operationalNotes.title: Operational notes
operationalNotes.description: Behavior that external integrators should expect from the v1 publishing API.
operationalNotes.rateLimitDescription: Markaestro enforces API-key rate limits plus destination-level throttling so one integration cannot overload a workspace or platform account.
operationalNotes.webhookSecretDescription: Store the returned webhook secret immediately. It is hashed at rest and not shown again.
operationalNotes.asyncDescription: Every publish returns a queued run. Poll the run endpoint or subscribe to webhooks instead of assuming immediate delivery.
operationalNotes.tiktokInboxTitle: TikTok inbox items need user completion
operationalNotes.tiktokInboxDescription: TikTok posts are pushed into the creator’s TikTok inbox first. Once TikTok finishes processing, the creator opens TikTok to finish caption, privacy, and posting. Scheduling triggers that inbox handoff; it does not publish publicly on the creator’s behalf.

createKeyDialog.title: Create API key
createKeyDialog.description: Create a scoped key for a single integration. Keep scopes narrow and rotate per workflow.
createKeyDialog.brandHelpEmpty: Create a brand first. Every API key is scoped to one brand.
createKeyDialog.brandHelpRequired: Required. The key only targets this brand; requests for any other brand are rejected.

createWebhookDialog.title: Add webhook endpoint
createWebhookDialog.description: Markaestro signs every delivery. Use a dedicated endpoint and verify the signature before processing events.

editKeyDialog.title: Edit API key permissions
editKeyDialog.description: Update the scopes for this key. Changes take effect immediately for future requests.

rotateKeyDialog.title: Rotate API key
rotateKeyDialog.description: Generates a new secret for this key. The old secret stops working immediately.

createdKeyDialog.description: This secret is shown once. Copy it now and store it securely.
createdKeyDialog.reviewGuide: Review the integration guide before distributing this key

createdWebhookDialog.title: Webhook secret created
createdWebhookDialog.description: This webhook signing secret is only shown once. Save it before you close this dialog. If you lose this secret, delete and recreate the endpoint.
createdWebhookDialog.headerNote: Markaestro sends `X-Markaestro-Event`, `X-Markaestro-Timestamp`, and `X-Markaestro-Signature` headers on every delivery.

toasts.permissionsUpdateFailed: Failed to update API key permissions

changePlan.confirmBodyMonthly: Your {plan} plan will be billed monthly from now on. Stripe prorates the change on your next invoice.

changePlan.toastNotOwner: Only the workspace owner can change billing. Switch to a workspace you own, or ask its owner.

changePlan.blockedTeamMembers: {current} team members including pending invites, {allowed} allowed.
